title: Nourishing British Jam Victoria Sponge
description: A savory and romantic British dish featuring jam and a unique ice-bath-shock step, made with ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients in a classic Victoria sponge form
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt
In a separate bowl, use an electric mixer to cream together the butter and sugar
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the milk
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined
Divide the batter evenly between two 8-inch round cake pans
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove from the oven and let cool in the pans for 5 minutes
Transfer the cakes to a wire rack to cool completely
Once the cakes are cool, place one layer on a serving plate and spread a layer of jam on top
Place the second layer on top and press gently to adhere
To add the ice-bath-shock, dip the cake in an ice bath for 30 seconds to create a gooey texture
